case_name: Smt Shwetha T vs Sri Manjunath

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Shwetha T, wife of respondent, assistant teacher
parties.respondent_defendant: Sri. Manjunath, husband of petitioner, assistant teacher

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent are teachers at Government Higher Primary School at Hosadurga Taluk. Respondent initiated M.C.No.288/2023 before the Family Court at Hubballi under Section 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, for decree of dissolution of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: In a petition under Section 24 of CPC for transfer of proceedings, more particularly in matrimonial cases, the hardship or inconvenience that would be caused to the wife shall have to be looked into.
legal_principles.held: Having heard the learned counsels for the parties and on perusal of petition papers, I am of the view that petition deserves to be allowed in the facts and circumstances of the case.

legal_principles.principle: The hardship or inconvenience that would be caused to the wife shall have to be looked into.
legal_principles.held: In a petition under Section 24 of CPC for transfer of proceedings, more particularly in matrimonial cases, the hardship or inconvenience that would be caused to the wife shall have to be looked into.

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's prayer to transfer M.C.No.288/2023 from Principal Family Court at Hubballi to the Court of Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Hosadurga was allowed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
responding to a petition for divorce
seeking transfer of case from Principal Family Court to Senior Judge
